scripts.build: pnpm run check:generated && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.bundle:development: pnpm run prepare:desktop && pnpm exec tauri build
scripts.check: pnpm run check:generated && tsc --noEmit && vitest run && vite build
scripts.generate:icons: pnpm exec tauri icon src-tauri/icon.svg --output src-tauri/icons
scripts.prepare:desktop: pnpm run generate:icons && pnpm run prepare:sidecars
scripts.tauri: pnpm run prepare:desktop && pnpm exec tauri
